title: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform name changes
scoped_claim: Vertex AI is now Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. Vertex AI Search maps to Agent Search, Vector Search 2.0 to Agent Retrieval, Agent Engine to Agent Runtime; RAG Engine keeps its name.

title: Gemini 3.8 Flash developer guide
scoped_claim: Model ID gemini-3.8-flash is GA with global and multi-region endpoints; REST path uses locations/global and generateContent.

title: Google Cloud Architecture Center
scoped_claim: Official reference architectures and design guidance for Google Cloud workloads.

title: Google Cloud official icons
scoped_claim: Official icon libraries (core products, category, legacy console). Download host services.google.com was blocked by this session's egress policy; four legacy console icons were acquired in a prior session with recorded hashes.

title: Cloud Run Button
scoped_claim: deploy.cloud.run accepts git_repo, revision and dir query parameters; an app.json can declare environment prompts.

title: AI Gateway: SDKs and APIs
scoped_claim: AI SDK 7 routes provider/model strings such as anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 through AI Gateway when AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY is set; gateway fallbacks and provider order are request options.

title: AI Gateway OIDC authentication
scoped_claim: Deployments on Vercel can authenticate to AI Gateway with the project's OIDC token instead of a stored API key.

title: Deploy Button
scoped_claim: vercel.com/new/clone accepts a repository-url (including a tree path to a subdirectory) and env prompts.

title: Vercel Workflow
scoped_claim: Managed durable workflows built on the open-source Workflow DevKit.

title: Vercel Sandbox
scoped_claim: Ephemeral isolated compute for untrusted, agent-generated code.

title: Deploy to Cloudflare buttons
scoped_claim: A button URL may point at a repository subdirectory that must be fully self-contained; KV, D1, R2, Hyperdrive, Vectorize, Secrets Store, Durable Objects, Workers AI and Queues are provisioned automatically.

title: AI Gateway Workers binding
scoped_claim: env.AI.run(model, input, { gateway: { id } }) routes Workers AI and supported third-party models through AI Gateway; the 'default' gateway is created on first use.

title: AI Search Workers binding
scoped_claim: AI Search (formerly AutoRAG) is bound through ai_search_namespaces and searched with env.AI_SEARCH.get(instance).search(); it does not run locally.

title: Agents SDK models
scoped_claim: Agents use Workers AI @cf/ models or vendor models routed through AI Gateway via the AI binding, without provider tokens in the Worker.

title: Amazon Bedrock managed knowledge base generally available
scoped_claim: A fully managed RAG knowledge base for Amazon Bedrock became generally available in June 2026.

title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
scoped_claim: Managed runtime, memory, gateway and identity services for deploying agents on AWS.

title: AWS Well-Architected Generative AI Lens
scoped_claim: AWS guidance for designing and operating generative AI workloads.

title: Microsoft Foundry documentation
scoped_claim: Azure AI Foundry is now named Microsoft Foundry; models, Agent Service and evaluation sit in one platform.

title: Azure Well-Architected AI workloads
scoped_claim: Microsoft guidance for AI workload design on Azure.

title: Railway documentation
scoped_claim: Container services, managed Postgres and Redis, cron and config-as-code on Railway.

title: Model Context Protocol specification
scoped_claim: Tool, resource and prompt exchange between clients and servers, with OAuth-based authorization for HTTP transports.

title: C4 model
scoped_claim: Context, container, component and deployment views for software architecture.

title: Structurizr DSL
scoped_claim: Text format for C4 models, including deployment environments and views.

title: React Flow
scoped_claim: Node-based interactive diagrams in React; @xyflow/react 12.12.0 was the npm latest on 2026-10-11.

title: Introducing gpt-image-2
scoped_claim: gpt-image-2 is available in the API with stronger text rendering, layout and editing, and resolutions up to 2K.

title: npm registry versions
scoped_claim: Recorded latest versions on 2026-10-11: ai 7.0.137, @ai-sdk/gateway 4.0.110, @xyflow/react 12.12.0, agents 0.28.0, wrangler 4.149.0, @google/genai 2.28.0, hono 4.13.13, next 16.4.0.

title: Google Cloud Partner Advantage
scoped_claim: Partner Advantage has a Service engagement for consulting, training and integration work; firms apply and select Service as their engagement of interest.

title: Vercel partners
scoped_claim: Vercel lists solution partners (agencies, consultancies, systems integrators) and runs a certified solution partner cohort; no public application criteria were found.

title: Cloudflare Partner Network
scoped_claim: The Partner Network includes services tracks (authorized service delivery, managed services) and a self-serve agency program in beta.

title: AWS Partner Network
scoped_claim: AWS recognizes services partners at Select, Advanced and Premier tiers; current requirements are published in Partner Central.

title: Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program overview
scoped_claim: Membership starts by joining the Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program and verifying a Partner Center account.

title: Claude Partner Network
scoped_claim: The Claude Partner Network, launched in March 2026, has a services track for consultancies with an application form; tier requirements appear only in secondary coverage.

title: OpenAI launches partner network
scoped_claim: Secondary coverage reports an OpenAI Partner Network announced in June 2026 with Select, Advanced and Elite tiers; the official page was not retrieved.

title: Join the NVIDIA Partner Network
scoped_claim: The NVIDIA Partner Network admits consulting, integration and solution partners with competency-based membership levels.

title: Railway templates and kickback
scoped_claim: Creators of templates published to the Railway marketplace earn a share of the usage their deployments generate; Railway also runs open source and technology partner programs.

title: Introducing the Model Context Protocol
scoped_claim: Anthropic introduced MCP on 2024-11-25 as an open standard for connecting AI assistants to the systems where data lives.

title: Donating the Model Context Protocol and establishing the Agentic AI Foundation
scoped_claim: On 2025-12-09 MCP moved to the Agentic AI Foundation, a directed fund under the Linux Foundation, with unchanged governance.

title: Announcing the Agent2Agent Protocol (A2A)
scoped_claim: Google announced the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, an open protocol for interoperability between AI agents, on 9 April 2025.

title: Linux Foundation Launches the Agent2Agent Protocol Project to Enable Secure, Intelligent Communication Between AI Agents
scoped_claim: On 23 June 2025 the Linux Foundation launched the Agent2Agent (A2A) project, an open protocol created by Google for agent-to-agent communication, under vendor-neutral governance; Google launched the protocol in April 2025.

title: Function calling and other API updates
scoped_claim: On 2023-06-13 OpenAI models gained function calling: they detect when to call a developer-declared function and return JSON matching its signature.

title: Introducing Structured Outputs in the API
scoped_claim: On 2024-08-06 OpenAI added Structured Outputs, constraining model output to a developer-supplied JSON Schema.

title: Semantic conventions for generative AI client spans
scoped_claim: GenAI client span conventions are in Development status; spans are named after the operation and requested model and carry gen_ai.* attributes.

title: Mermaid documentation
scoped_claim: Text-defined flowcharts and sequence diagrams rendered in browsers and in GitHub Markdown.

title: draw.io documentation
scoped_claim: Editable diagram files in the draw.io XML format, opened by diagrams.net and its desktop and IDE apps.
